subject: RSVP boost playbook & tracking map for LLM Ops briefing
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataForge Marketing <marketing@dataforge.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@dataforge.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: RSVP boost playbook & tracking map for LLM Ops briefing

Team + DataForge —

Attaching the latest target segment export and my draft email copy (v3). Goal: maximize RSVPs for the Sept 26 LLM Operational Best Practices briefing while keeping CPLs reasonable. Two asks for today:

1) Quick review of the proposed RSVP reminder cadence and segment assignment (below).
2) Confirm tracking link mapping so we can generate HubSpot CTAs and UTM-ed calendar links before Friday.

Proposed cadence (per segment):
- Day 0: initial invite (personalized subject for high-value leads)
- Day 3: short reminder (social proof + speaker highlight)
- Day 7: last-chance (explicit time + recording note)
- Day 10: final nudge to registrants who opened but didn't register

Segments in target_segments.csv:
- Enterprise prospects (named accounts + AE-owned)
- Product trial users (last 90 days)
- Platform eng / ML leads (developer-focused copy)

Tracking map: see tracking_link_map.xlsx — initial mapping includes UTM params by segment + subject line variant. Example link for DataForge marketing sends: https://redwood.ai/rsvp?utm_source=dataforge&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=llm-ops-0926&utm_content=subjectA

Notes:
- Marissa: can you prioritize subject line A/B and send subject variants by EOD?
- Hannah: can you own the calendar invite + regional times (we need EU-friendly options)?

Attachments: target_segments.csv, email_copy_v3.docx, tracking_link_map.xlsx

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataForge Marketing <marketing@dataforge.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@dataforge.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RSVP boost playbook & tracking map for LLM Ops briefing

Jordan —

Thanks for the deck and exports. Quick thoughts after skimming:

1) Subject line variants (my picks):
- Subject A (eng-led): "How top teams cut LLM inference cost by 3x — RSVP"
- Subject B (exec): "Reducing inference spend without sacrificing latency — live briefing"
- Subject C (dev): "LLM serving patterns for predictable latency — join our demo"

2) Cadence tweaks:
- Keep Day 0/Day 3/Day 7 but swap Day 10 to only target 'opened but not registered' with an exclusive offer (e.g., short whitepaper).
- For enterprise AEs: delay Day 3 reminder by 24 hours to allow personalized outreach.

3) Segment mapping suggestions (add to tracking_link_map):
- enterprise -> utm_segment=enterprise
- trialers -> utm_segment=trial_users
- eng_ml -> utm_segment=engineering

Example final RSVP URL (tracking_link_map.xlsx row):
https://redwood.ai/rsvp?utm_source=dataforge&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=llm-ops-0926&utm_content=subjectA&utm_segment=enterprise&hs_contact=@@contact_id@@

4) A/B testing plan: run subject A vs B only for enterprise and trialers (20/80 traffic split) and measure CTR->RSVP conversion after 72 hours.

I'm attaching a one-page playbook snippet in the Drive link; will drop subject variants into email_copy_v3.docx and push a cleaned tracking map by EOD.

Marissa Cole
Head of Demand Gen | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@dataforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RSVP boost playbook & tracking map for LLM Ops briefing

Hi Jordan / Marissa / Hannah —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick questions from our side:

- Can you confirm the session time in both PT and CET? Our EMEA team wants a CET-friendly option or a clear note about the recording availability.
- Will the recording and slides be sharable post-event? We plan to promote to our internal list but need to mention availability.
- Any objections to adding a sponsor blurb and link to the DataForge team in the first reminder? We can co-brand the calendar invite if that helps conversion.

If you can confirm the tracking params we'll pass along a cleaned contact export for smarter hs_contact tokenization.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Demand Gen | DataForge
samantha.li@dataforge.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@dataforge.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RSVP boost playbook & tracking map for LLM Ops briefing

Samantha —

Confirmed: session time is Sept 26 at 10:00 AM PT / 19:00 CET. We'll include a CET-friendly note and mark the calendar invite with both times. Recording and slides: yes — recording will be available within 24 hours and slides will be provided as a gated download (we'll share link to registrants).

Sponsor blurb: fine with a short co-branded sentence and DataForge logo in the calendar invite only. Please send the logo file (PNG, 300px width) and a 1-line blurb.

Action owners I assigned in the playbook (Drive folder):
- Calendar invite + localized times: Hannah (owns)
- HubSpot tracking + RSVP URLs: Marissa (owns)
- AE personalization + enterprise follow-up: Jordan (owns)

I'll upload the finalized calendar ICSs (PT/CET) and the co-brand version to the Drive link by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Events & Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
